title: Extract pure app logic into a testable StacksCore package
acceptance: A local package Packages/StacksCore exists, dependency-free, tested via swift test on macOS with no simulator
Contrast ratio math moves there and ReaderContrastAudit's pairs are asserted as real tests, so the palette cannot regress silently
SearchSnippetBuilder moves there with tests covering the ranking rule, including a case where a dense later passage must beat a glancing first mention
The whitespace-straddling query case is covered by a test
The app depends on the package and behaviour is unchanged; no view or SwiftData code moves
verify.sh runs the new package's tests and the whole gate stays under 30 seconds
notes: Implements D-0002. Note this task is deliberately allowed to touch verify.sh — normally X3 forbids it, but wiring a new package into the gate is the one legitimate reason, and the overseer is granting it explicitly here rather than leaving the agent to discover the prohibition mid-task. Depends on T-0015 so the snippet code being moved is final. Keep the move a MOVE: no behaviour changes riding along, so the diff stays reviewable.
